title: PushT reproduction artifact: configuration, compute and sampling in a robot learning benchmark
description:
Code, per-episode evaluation results, and source patches for a study of how much of a reported success rate is attributable to the policy configuration rather than to the method or to the training budget.

Contents: 65+ evaluation runs of Diffusion Policy, ACT and SmolVLA on the PushT benchmark (200 episodes each, paired initial states); the 2x2 factorial over crop_shape and GroupNorm/backbone initialisation; eleven disjoint 50-episode seed blocks used to measure the evaluation noise floor; training seeds for the variance decomposition; four patches against LeRobot v0.6.1 that make evaluation deterministic and per-episode results auditable.

Model weights are archived separately (see related identifiers). The manuscript is included under paper/.

creators.name: Huang, Yandong
creators.affiliation: Beijing Information Science and Technology University

notes: Evaluation protocol: 200 episodes, 300-step horizon, fixed evaluation seed, 22 synchronous environments. All comparisons are paired on the same 200 initial states.
